item.title: Indonesia: Digital Competence for a Safer, Inclusive Society
item.description: Indonesia is actively advancing digital literacy and responsible technology use, focusing on youth and vulnerable groups to build a safe, inclusive, resilient and digitally competent society for all citizens.

item.title: Malaysia: Smart Aquaculture Strategies Drive Resilience
item.description: Malaysia is strengthening its aquaculture sector’s resilience through digital monitoring, early warning systems and advanced breeding technologies to safeguard production against climate-related disruptions.

item.title: The Philippines: AI-Powered e-TURO Pilot Drives Digital Learning
item.description: The Philippines is advancing inclusive, future-ready education by piloting AI-powered learning, expanding digital access and providing skills programmes to empower students and underserved youth.

item.title: Singapore, China Advance Tech-Driven Economic Collaboration
item.description: Singapore and China are strengthening cooperation in technology, innovation and the digital economy, advancing digital connectivity, financial innovation and research partnerships to support regional growth.

item.title: Malaysia: Next-Gen Technologies for a Quantum and Satellite Future
item.description: Malaysia is advancing its telecommunications sector with quantum and satellite technologies, strengthening infrastructure, security and skilled talent to drive a competitive, connected digital future.

item.title: Indonesia: Multi-Faceted Measures to Safeguard Children Online
item.description: Indonesia is taking a multi-pronged approach to effectively protect children online through strict regulations, robust enforcement against digital platforms and widespread public and parental education.

item.title: Australia: Responsible AI Network for Victoria Youth Services
item.description: Swinburne University has launched the Responsible AI in Youth Sectors Network (RAI YSN) to guide ethical and effective adoption of AI across all youth-focused services and community programmes in Victoria

item.title: India: Boosting Cyber Resilience, Safeguarding Citizens
item.description: India has strengthened cybercrime prevention and financial fraud protection through I4C, advanced platforms, inter-agency coordination, training and robust measures across key sectors, boosting resilience.

item.title: Hong Kong: UniVenture Boosts Student-Led Innovation at HKUST
item.description: HKUST and an investment partner launch UniVenture to incubate student-led AI and technology startups through funding mentorship and commercialisation support.

item.title: Vietnam: The Role of Trust in Shaping the Digital Economy
item.description: Vietnam highlighted trust as the foundation of its next phase of digital development at Internet Day 2025, focusing on a safe, inclusive Internet to support sustainable socio-economic growth and robust digital institutions.
